classes.EXTENSIVE_RESPONSE: proved exact fixed rational lower fraction of N on infinite family, not necessarily N
classes.NO_CAUSAL_RESPONSE: no tag other than directly intervened lineage has action/count response
classes.SUBEXTENSIVE_RESPONSE: unbounded but exact algebraic bound rules out linear participation

count_semantics.GLOBAL_CARTESIAN_HISTORY_WEIGHTED_COUNT: retained diagnostic only; changes caused solely by independent Cartesian multiplicity rescaling do not create causal participants
count_semantics.TAG_LINEAGE_COUNT: C_i(x): exact CPBC multiplicity generated by tagged source i, without multiplying by independent other-tag branch/order factors

predicates.ACTION_CHANGE_e(i): 1 iff baseline and perturbed allowed local action sets for tag i differ at matched boundary e
predicates.TAG_COUNT_CHANGE_e(i): 1 iff exact source-lineage tagged CPBC count distribution C_i differs

primary_window: e=0..3, the frozen baseline first-aligned-return horizon; perturbed endpoint status is audited independently
ratio_storage: RESPONSE_PARTICIPANT_COUNT:N exact integer pair only; never physical probability
